history.dynasty: None (Sikh shrine of the Guru period)
history.period: Guru Har Rai Ji's visit dated to 1651 (per 99mustsee.com); present structures modern
history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - keep-or-drop decision needed: this is a SIKH gurdwara, not a Hindu temple. CSV TOWN CORRECTION: the gurdwara is NOT in Hoshiarpur town itself - it stands in the village of Harian Belan (Harian Velan), ~11-12 km from Hoshiarpur on the Hoshiarpur-Chandigarh road (near Bajraur / Gurdwara Shaheedan), still in Hoshiarpur district. (One low-quality aggregator, seawatersports.com, places a 'Gurdwara Harian Velan' in Fatehgarh Sahib district associated with Guru Tegh Bahadur - CONFLICT flagged; the Tripadvisor reviews, the gurdwara's own site harianbelan.com, and the MakeMyTrip listing all locate this shrine at Hoshiarpur and associate it with Guru Har Rai, and the Fatehgarh Sahib entry is treated as unreliable.) TRADITION CORRECTION: the documented association is with Guru Har Rai Ji, the 7th Sikh Guru (MakeMyTrip titles it 'Gurudwara Harian Vellan Patshahi VII'), who visited the village in 1651 with his entourage; per local tradition he was impressed by the devotion of Baba Prajapati and imparted spiritual knowledge to the Sikh sangat. The brief's 'Bhai Joga Singh / Guru Gobind Singh era' association is NOT supported by any consulted source and is corrected here - the Bhai Joga Singh sakhi belongs to a different site, Gurdwara Bhai Joga Singh at Mohalla Shekhon near the clock tower in Hoshiarpur town. 'Harian Velan' means 'green vines' in Punjabi: evergreen vines at the shrine's door are said to have stayed green for 300+ years by the Guru's boon. The shrine is maintained by Nihang Singhs; there is a small pond nearby called 'Moti sarovar'; stay and food arrangements exist with the usual gurdwara rules (no intoxicants, head covered).

name: Gurdwara Harian Velan
town: Harian Belan village (CSV town 'Hoshiarpur' is APPROXIMATE - the gurdwara is ~11-12 km from Hoshiarpur town on the Hoshiarpur-Chandigarh road)
town_description: Harian Belan is a village in Hoshiarpur district on the Hoshiarpur-Chandigarh road (NH 503), about 11-12 km from Hoshiarpur town and near Gurdwara Shaheedan. Hoshiarpur town itself is a historic Doaba-region city in the Shivalik foothills with an archaeological museum, Sheesh Mahal, and several Sikh shrines.

travel.airport: Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport, Amritsar (~140 km); Chandigarh International Airport (~110 km).
travel.railway: Hoshiarpur railway station (~11-12 km); Jalandhar City (~50 km) is the nearest major railhead.
travel.road: On the Hoshiarpur-Chandigarh road (NH 503): driving from Hoshiarpur towards Chandigarh, take the right turn at ~7 km where a gate and board mark the direction to the gurdwara; the shrine is ~11-12 km from Hoshiarpur. Auto-rickshaw/taxi from Hoshiarpur town.

visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM - 8:30 PM daily (per the gurdwara's listing; verify on arrival).
